milkyWay OBS Plugin. Uses the separately replaceable projectM shared library (LGPL 2.1), OBS host API (GPL 2 or later), OBS media-playback sources (ISC, notices retained in the corresponding source), FFmpeg headers/runtime interfaces, projectm-eval and HLSLParser (MIT). FFmpeg and OBS runtime DLLs are supplied by the installed OBS distribution and are not included. Corresponding engine, wrapper and plugin source/build recipes accompany this application in the source archive. First-party distribution license is recorded in the source root LICENSE when chosen.
